basic_details.job_title: Bangalore University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Bangalore University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://bangaloreuniversity.karnataka.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bangalore University Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Bangalore University Guest Faculty recruitment is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess NET/SLET/Ph.D and have completed the 10+2+3+2 pattern of education to be eligible for the Guest Faculty position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the Guest Faculty position at Bangalore University?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty position ranges from Rs. 680/- to Rs. 50000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 200/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SC/ST category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST category candidates is Rs. 100/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and a Demo Class.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Bangalore University.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit mentioned for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for specific age limit details, as it is not explicitly mentioned in the summary.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.
